business_summary: Nasdaq, Inc. (Nasdaq: NDAQ) is the exchange holding company operating The Nasdaq Stock Market. Its one sourced role on this chain is market-surveillance-and-integrity: its FY2025 10-K discloses that its surveillance software, built for banks and brokers, also powers surveillance for more than 50 exchanges and 22 regulators, the monitoring layer any CFTC-regulated prediction-market venue has to buy.

exposure_summary.narrative: Nasdaq holds one sourced role on prediction-market-plumbing: market-surveillance-and-integrity (EMERGING, chain position 3), a vendor role rather than the venue itself. FY2025 revenue was USD 8,262.0M (9.9% three-year CAGR) with a 28.2% operating margin, net income of USD 1,788.0M, and strong cash generation (operating cash flow USD 2,255.0M, FCF margin 24.1%). Piotroski scores 9/9 (STRONG) and Beneish -2.528 (CLEAN, 12/12 inputs). Net debt to EBITDA is 3.22x on an EBITDA proxy of USD 2,476.0M, mixing a 2026-06-30 balance-sheet instant against the FY2025 income statement.
